name: Cloud Raft
desc: Over open air only: a cloud platform you can stand on, there for 30s. Squadmates gliding over it or standing on it get their gliders cooled.
src: docs/SOURCE_UTILITIES.md: over the abyss only; casts after 0.3 s (the effect's delay) and floats you for it [P-1.03]; refills ally gliders, 2 gliders' worth a second (ours)
